source_contract: DB-Perf-01 workload specification retained by reference; no prior results transferred

cases.business_operation: Composite-key order lookup, including an absent key; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `FindAsync` (`O`), plus a matching generated narrow projection (`D/R`). Distinguish full-entity from narrow-projection measurements.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: tenant and order predicates. Verify 0/1 row, all selected fields, exact key, version, and absence.

cases.business_operation: Order search with optional customer, minimum amount, and time range; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `WhereIf` and typed predicates (`D`); a finite reusable shape per enabled-filter combination (`R`). Bind only active predicates.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: actually construct the same enabled predicates. An all-purpose nullable-OR SQL shape is a different plan and must be labelled. Compare ordered matches and optional-filter truth tables.

cases.business_operation: Order page with nullable customer display name; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `LeftJoin`, nullable join projection (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: equivalent LEFT JOIN. Check missing customer separately from a matched customer with a NULL field, stable order, and exact page.

cases.business_operation: Order/customer/detail three-table item view; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: two explicit joins and a generated projection (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: three-table JOIN with tenant/order composite association. Check multiplicity, item values, and no cross-tenant leakage.

cases.business_operation: Customer spending and order counts filtered by HAVING; normal heavy read
cases.korda_route: Available: `GroupBy`, `CountRows`, `Sum`, `Having` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: identical grouping and HAVING. Check NULL-customer group, exact monetary total, count, and group ordering.

cases.business_operation: Product sales-quantity ranking; normal heavy read
cases.korda_route: Available: detail root, product grouping, quantity sum, deterministic rank order (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: equivalent aggregate and top-N. Check every group, ties, secondary ordering, and integer overflow bounds in the seeded data.

cases.business_operation: Next order page across repeated timestamps; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: complete composite `QueryCursor`/`SeekAfter` ordering (`D`). A separate `R` variant may declare the equivalent typed lexicographic predicate with query parameters only after equivalence is verified; do not assume the cursor helper itself exposes reusable placeholders.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: identical lexicographic continuation predicate. Check first, middle, and final pages without duplicate or missing rows.

cases.business_operation: Deep offset page of the same ordered order list; normal heavy read
cases.korda_route: Available: complete unique `OrderBy`/`ThenBy`, `Skip`, `Take` (`D/R` for a fixed page shape).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same OFFSET/LIMIT and index/statistics state. Compare the exact slice from the canonical full sequence.

cases.business_operation: Order page followed by bounded batch loading of details; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `LoadRelatedAsync` with composite `EntityKey` list (`O`), page query `D/R`. Include key construction/grouping required by the normal API.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: page plus the same association batching contract. Check parent input order, duplicate keys, empty associations, child order if promised, SQL count, and empty-input no-SQL behavior.

cases.business_operation: Narrow reconciliation queue containing only keys and versions; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: generated narrow `DbProjection` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: return exactly the same columns. Fully consume and verify all keys/versions; do not let native fetch fewer fields or skip decoding.

cases.business_operation: Wide manual-review detail with memo, JSON, and money; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: generated wide `DbProjection` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: exact wide projection. Materialize equivalent owned strings/JSON/money; verify lengths, bytes or typed values, NULLs, and no silent truncation.

cases.business_operation: Large streaming ledger export; normal heavy read
cases.korda_route: Available: `AsAsyncEnumerable` (`D/R`). Keep ownership until enumeration/disposal completes.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: direct streamed result. Consume every row into the same business digest/aggregate, record rows/batches and peak retained buffers; counting rows alone is insufficient.

cases.business_operation: Orders having no detail rows; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: LEFT JOIN with `HasMatch().Not()` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: matching anti-join. Verify all empty associations and no false positives from nullable child fields.

cases.business_operation: Customers missing contact details with a display fallback; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `IsNull` plus `CoalesceReference` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: matching NULL/COALESCE expression. Compare canonical string values and count; distinguish NULL from empty string.

cases.business_operation: Typed order settings and exact monetary values; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `DbCodec`, source-generated JSON context, provider-specific money codec (`D/R`). This is typed JSON mapping, not a JSON-path claim.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same columns and decoding. Compare JSON members semantically, exact decimal value/scale, and nullable values.

cases.business_operation: Orders containing a qualifying product/quantity selected by a subquery; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: typed `IN(QuerySelection<T>)` (`D/R`). Constrain the same tenant in both inner and outer queries.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same IN subquery. Check duplicate inner matches, empty inner result, and reused local IDs in other tenants.

cases.business_operation: Filtered work queue built through a bounded CTE; normal heavy read
cases.korda_route: Available: `CommonTable<T>.Create` and `With` (`D/R`). Preserve immutable CTE-body and declared projection rules.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same CTE body and outer filter. Verify exact selected fields/order; capture materialization/inlining plan differences.

cases.business_operation: Per-customer running spending and row number; normal heavy read
cases.korda_route: Available: `Window`, `Sum(...).Over`, `RowNumber` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: identical PARTITION BY, full tie-breaking ORDER BY, and ROWS frame. Verify each cumulative amount and sequence number.

cases.business_operation: Combined order population from two business partitions; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `Combine(UnionAll)` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: UNION ALL with the same final deterministic ordering. Preserve duplicates and verify partition contributions and total rows.

cases.business_operation: Intersection of two independently filtered order groups; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `Combine(Intersect)` (`D/R`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: INTERSECT. Verify duplicate elimination, exact common keys, and the empty-intersection case.

cases.business_operation: Distinct active-customer population or distinct count; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `Distinct` or `Count(..., distinct: true)` (`D/R`). Freeze one chosen result contract per case variant.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: matching DISTINCT/COUNT DISTINCT. Verify NULL rules and repeated-customer deduplication; do not compare a list producer to a scalar count producer.

cases.business_operation: Escaped literal customer/product search; normal
cases.korda_route: Available: `ContainsLiteral`, `StartsWithLiteral`, or explicit `Like` (`D/R`). Freeze the chosen business predicate.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: identical escaping and allowed collation. Seed `%`, `_`, escape characters, and empty values; keep an explicitly comparable primary character set and report Unicode edge cases separately.

cases.business_operation: Create an order and consume returned fields; normal write
cases.korda_route: Available: `InsertReturningAsync` (`O`). Include normal entity/parameter preparation and completion; list application-owned entity allocation separately.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: matching INSERT RETURNING and transaction boundary. Verify affected row, returned values, and durable row; include equivalent decoding.

cases.business_operation: Patch only note/version, including explicit NULL; normal write
cases.korda_route: Available: `Changes<T>.Set` and `UpdateAsync` (`O`), or root-only Fluent update (`D`).
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: exactly the same SET columns and predicates. Verify written NULL versus omitted columns; money/settings must remain unchanged.

cases.business_operation: Two writers race an optimistic version update; separate contention scenario
cases.korda_route: Available: `UpdateCheckedAsync` (`O`). Freeze the shared key/version and retry policy.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: matching version predicate and affected-row check. Record both planned operations, winner, stale-version conflict, retries, durable values, and final version; never omit losers from counts.

cases.business_operation: Transaction reads validation state, updates order/detail, then commits; normal write
cases.korda_route: Available: `InTransactionAsync` or explicit `BeginTransactionAsync` (`O`). Use the same public route before/after.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same BEGIN/isolation, read/write order, COMMIT, and acknowledgment boundary. Verify cross-table invariant and durable state.

cases.business_operation: Business failure after partial transaction work, followed by rollback; separate fault scenario
cases.korda_route: Available: transaction callback/explicit rollback (`O`). Preserve original business exception and recorded transaction outcome.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same partial work and ROLLBACK. Check no partial durability, reusable connection or documented discard, and original error versus cleanup error.

cases.business_operation: Bounded batch insertion of order details; normal write
cases.korda_route: Available: `InsertManyAsync` (`O`). Freeze batch size, all-versus-per-batch atomicity, input enumeration, and generated/owned results.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same insert batching and parameter counts. Native COPY is a separate optimization comparison, not the equivalent primary cell. Verify rows, batch progress, atomicity, and duplicates/errors.

cases.business_operation: Upsert using an explicit unique conflict target; normal write
cases.korda_route: Available: `UpsertAsync` (`O`). Freeze update columns and insert/update branch distribution.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: same conflict target and update expressions. Verify both insert and update branches, affected rows as each provider defines them, and durable business values.

cases.business_operation: Version-checked deletion of a detail record; normal write
cases.korda_route: Available: `DeleteCheckedAsync` (`O`). Expected-conflict variants belong to the separate contention classification.
cases.equivalence_oracle: `S`: matching key/version delete. Verify affected row, parent retention, stale version handling, and durable deletion.

cases.business_operation: Exactly 100 order-summary DTOs in a list, including owned customer strings, keys, timestamps and exact money.
cases.korda_route: Public Fluent projection and ToListAsync, generated mapping; separate dynamic and reusable-shape variants.
cases.equivalence_oracle: Dapper.AOT returns the same DTO type and list ownership, exactly 100 rows and all identical fields. Attribute business list/DTO/string allocation separately from library overhead.
